The full record isfree with an accountor through the [API](https://indexed.vc/docs/api). ## About Vim is a healthcare infrastructure platform that connects providers, payers, EHRs, and health tech developers through a powerful in-workflow integration layer. The platform embeds real-time data, AI-driven apps, and actionable insights directly into clinical workflows at the point of care — without requiring portals or additional clicks. Vim enables payers to deploy programs inside provider EHRs, allows health tech innovators to scale into clinical workflows without EHR contracts, and helps provider networks close care gaps and improve value-based care performance. The platform is HIPAA, SOC 2, and HITRUST certified. Summary It lists 51–200 employees. It has raised $96.2M in total across 4 rounds, most recently a $60.0M Series C round in May 2021. Investors include GreatPoint Ventures, Optum Ventures and Walgreens Boots Alliance.
